# Skill Sentinel
> Linter + security scanner for AI agent skills — paste a SKILL.md, get an A–F grade with evidence-bound findings. 100% local, nothing uploaded.

Heuristic pattern engine that grades AI agent skills A–F across six categories: prompt injection, data exfiltration, destructive commands, privilege grants, frontmatter lint, structure. Runs 100% locally in the browser.

## Live
- App: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-skill-sentinel/
- Try it: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-skill-sentinel/

## Features
- A–F grades with evidence-bound findings
- 6 finding categories (SEC-PI/EX/DE/PR, Q-FM/ST)
- ?scan=<url-to-raw-skill-file> deep links
- Zero-dependency UMD scanner.js (browser + Node)
- Machine-readable findings schema
- 27/27 tests

## Machine-readable
- schema: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-skill-sentinel/schema/findings.schema.json

## Honest limits
Heuristic, not a sandbox: false positives and false negatives exist. A clean scan is NOT a safety certificate — always read a skill before trusting it.
